maya: Heads up — production API gateway started returning 502s around 2025-12-04T12:04:xx PST. Telemetry shows route flapping between primary-cluster and canary-compute for /v1/generate. I'm planning an emergency header override to force fallback-model routing. Any objections? :warning:

jamal: On it. Please don't stomp on the policy directly; use the emergency toggle in the admin console or the emergency route API. Paste what you're going to set so we can audit.

maya: Will set a route policy that matches path `/v1/generate` and injects header `X-Route-Override: fallback` via the emergency toggle. Example I'm about to run (using internal admin):

```
curl -sS -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/admin/routes/emergency-toggle" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","override_header":{"X-Route-Override":"fallback"},"state":"on","note":"prod 502s - emergency fallback"}'
```

maya: I'll also tag the change with `emergency:prod-fallback` for observability.

ops-bot: Incident IN-2026-47 created by maya. Priority: P1. Notifying #incidents and oncall.

dave: Heads up — fallback-model here is the quantized 4bit variant on dedicated-small. Latency should drop but expect some quality regression on long-form. Make sure the quality budget is OK. Also ensure quotas and rate-limits map correctly to the fallback policy (token units differ).

leo: If you flip, add metadata so dashboards can filter: `override_origin=emergency-toggle` and `policy_id` returned by the API. I'll create a temporary tile in the console to surface the last 30m with that tag.

jamal: I'm going to run the toggle now and do a smoke test (100 synthetic requests) to verify 200s and error rate. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 1.5% or p95 token latency > 350ms -> immediate revert. Also watch token-usage delta.

maya: Proceeding. tagging SRE oncall @jamal.

jamal: Toggle requested...

deploy-bot: route-policy request accepted. request_id=rp-2026-118, awaiting activation.

jamal: Activation response: 200 OK. policy_id=pol-4592. Toggle state=on.

deploy-bot: policy pol-4592 activated on gateway cluster-primary at 2025-12-04T12:09:12Z.

jamal: Running smoke canary (100 reqs) against prod-reads endpoint with header `X-Route-Override:fallback`. Results: 100/100 responses, 0.8% error (all timeouts < 500ms), p95 latency 260ms. Token usage delta +8%.

dave: Good. Keep an eye on quality monitors (evals) — push a few key prompt-sets through the fallback and compare to master.

maya: Observability tags landed. Leo added `Emergency Override` dashboard tile.

leo: Added. Also patched the routing traces view to show `policy_id` and `override_header`.

jamal: Leaving the toggle on while we stabilize traffic. Plan: 30m stabilization window, then gradual rollback to original policy if behavior is stable. Rollback steps documented below in case we need immediate revert:

1) Toggle off emergency via admin API:
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/admin/routes/emergency-toggle" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"policy_id":"pol-4592","state":"off","note":"rollback - emergency off"}'
```
2) If toggle fails, revert to previous policy id `pol-4587` with:
```
PATCH https://console.internal/api/v1/policies/pol-4592/revert -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
3) If policy APIs are unreachable, apply header-mutation at the gateway layer (last resort) via `gatewayctl` on the control plane nodes: `gatewayctl set header /v1/generate X-Route-Override:primary --apply-immediate` (requires oncall approval).

maya: Documenting this in the incident ticket.

ops-bot: Monitoring rule `prod_generate_error_rate` alerted 4 times during the last 10m but stabilized after toggle.

jamal: After 30m, metrics still look good: error_rate down to baseline, latency stable. I'm starting phased rollback to original routing (will flip policy to `pol-4587` traffic-weight=100%).

deploy-bot: rollback request received for pol-4592 -> pol-4587. operation_id=rb-3301.

jamal: Rollback complete at 2025-12-04T12:40:22Z. policy pol-4592 state=off, active policy=pol-4587. Post-rollback checks: 200/200, error_rate baseline, p95 latency returned to pre-incident numbers.

maya: Closing emergency override. Adding note: cause suspected mis-evaluated canary routing rule where a new header-based matcher lost precedence when cache populated. Follow-up action: create regression test for route-match precedence and bake into rollout checks.

leo: I'll add a dashboard alert for unexpected policy flips and a per-policy precedence test panel.

dave: Suggest adding a preflight that simulates cache-warmup and checks matcher precedence. I'll add a checklist to the rollout UX PR.

ops-bot: Incident IN-2026-47 updated: status=resolved. Summary: Emergency header override used to mitigate 502s; rollback successful; follow-ups created: REG-3432 (route matcher tests), DOCS-112 (runbook edits).

maya: Thanks everyone. Postmortem next week. :thumbsup:
